why: Both notes report the numbers correctly. A cites many pages two to four pages off and raises a dubious Fig. 1 inconsistency. B's pages are accurate and its coverage of Table 5 is fuller; its one weak inconsistency is minor.

wrong.claim: Inconsistency: text cites Fig. 1 for Muon at 1× batch, but Fig. 1 shows only 2× and 3×
wrong.pdf: Fig. 1's caption mentions 2x and 3x, but the plot legend includes 'Muon 1x' and 'AdamW 1x', so the 1× comparison is in the figure.

wrong_pages.item: Muon vs SOAP at 1×/2×/4× with no ramp-up (Fig. 7)
MOP and KL-SOAP slightly below Muon at a 24M-token batch (Fig. 8)

only_here: Sec. 5.4.1 (reference SOAP omits the current gradient) vs Sec. 5.4.2 ('this implementation was present with SOAP') contradiction
Same model named 72B-A8B in Table 1 / Fig. 2 but '8B Hybrid MTP' in Table 5
FP32 (2^-23) and BF16 (2^-7) precision floors for Newton-Schulz
Max LR range 8e-4 to 1.6e-3; MoE aux-loss coefficient 1e-4; data are 1T/3T subsets of Nemotron-3

wrong.claim: Inconsistency: abstract says 'up to 100M tokens' but the largest printed batches are 50M/75M
wrong.pdf: Fig. 7 runs at 4x GBS, which is about 100M tokens (4 × 25M, or 96M from the 24M base), so the 100M claim is supported. B notes '4x GBS' itself.
